intent: Record which agent drafted each proposed element.

edit.summary:
I added a way to record which agent drafted each proposed element. All changes are in `SKILL.md`, in the Authoring section. I didn't change `EXAMPLES.md`.

- **Element object:** it has a new optional string property, `drafted_by`.
- **`propose_element` action:** it has a new optional parameter, `drafted_by`, and now sets `target.drafted_by = params.drafted_by`. I added a sentence saying to name the drafting agent there and that the name stays on the element.

I made it a parameter because `propose_element` is taken by the owner. The actor on the action is therefore never the agent, so the agent's name has to be passed in. The parameter is optional, so existing calls and examples still work. An element proposed without it will have no drafting agent recorded.
